title: End User Portal — Spec 002 Implementation
description: Build a simplified End User Portal on top of the existing Clusters backend. Wizard-driven team creation from templates, plain-English dashboards, no raw config exposed. See .specify/specs/002-end-user-portal.md for full spec. Four phases: Foundation (routing + templates), Wizard & Gallery, Dashboard, Polish & Settings.
